> Let $n\geq 1$ and define $L_n$ to be the least common multiple of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and $a_n$ by $\sum_{1\leq k\leq n}\frac{1}{k}=\frac{a_n}{L_n}$. Is it true that $(a_n,L_n)=1$ occurs for infinitely many $n$?
